name: McGhee Tyson Airport
before:
The airport for Knoxville, 12 miles south of the city at Alcoa, Tennessee.

Its real value is the national park. The Great Smoky Mountains National Park is a 30 minute drive away, which makes this the sensible arrival for that trip rather than a larger airport further off.

It is served by several major airlines and employs around 2,700 people. Endeavor Air has a maintenance base here and Allegiant Air a crew base.

Two parallel runways serve the 2,250 acre site at an elevation of 986 feet, the longer at 10,000 feet. General aviation is handled by Signature Aviation.

The airport also hosts McGhee Tyson Air National Guard Base, home to a Tennessee Air National Guard air refuelling wing.

It is named after Charles McGhee Tyson, a United States Navy pilot killed in the First World War.
after:
The airport for Knoxville, 12 miles south of the city at Alcoa, Tennessee. It handled about 3.6 million passengers in 2025 and is served by several major airlines.

The National Park Service names it as the nearest major airport in Tennessee to the Great Smoky Mountains National Park, about 45 miles west of the park's Gatlinburg entrance.

Endeavor Air has a maintenance base here and Allegiant Air a crew base. Two parallel runways serve the airport, the longer at 10,000 feet. General aviation is handled by Signature Aviation.

The airport also hosts a Tennessee Air National Guard air refuelling wing.

It is named after Charles McGhee Tyson, a pilot killed in the First World War.

claims.inAfter: The National Park Service names it as the nearest major airport in Tennessee to the Great Smoky Mountains National Park, about 45 miles west of the park's Gatlinburg entrance.
claims.note: Replaces 'a 30 minute drive away, which makes this the sensible arrival for that trip rather than a larger airport further off'. The park's own directions page is the authority on getting there, so the sentence is attributed to it. The facts behind it are borne out elsewhere: the authority's 2025 annual report puts the airport 'in the rolling foothills of the Great Smoky Mountains' and says it 'benefitted from its proximity' to the park, and Wikipedia calls it a short drive away.

The nearest major airport in Tennessee is the McGhee-Tyson Airport (TYS) located just south of Knoxville in Alcoa.
This airport is approximately 45 miles west of the Gatlinburg entrance to the park.
McGhee Tyson Airport benefitted from its proximity to the Great Smoky Mountains National Park.

claims.wasBefore: The Great Smoky Mountains National Park is a 30 minute drive away, which makes this the sensible arrival for that trip rather than a larger airport further off.
